title: Debate Topic Domain Transfer: Does Judge-Accuracy Lift Survive Outside QuALITY?

original_idea.body:
# Debate Topic Domain Transfer: Does Judge-Accuracy Lift Survive Outside QuALITY?

**Problem:** It is unclear whether the debate-vs-consultancy lift generalizes to domains without a clean ground-truth passage to quote.

**Direction:** Reuse open debate/consultancy harnesses with small open models. Run the same two-turn debate protocol on three contrasting domains: citable factual QA, subjective ethical-dilemma judgments (fuzzy reward), and math word problems. Measure judge-accuracy delta in each domain.

**Why it matters:** Scalable oversight must work on fuzzy-reward tasks where there is no quotable passage.

**Relevant context:** Kenton et al. 2024 (arXiv:2407.04622); Khan et al. 2024 (arXiv:2402.06782).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: mapping where debate's lift evaporates on fuzzy-reward tasks targets a recognized critical regime.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Reuses open harness across three domains; multi-domain setup is guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused per-domain accuracy-delta study; three domains add some dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Fuzzy-reward oversight generalization, foundational, external-friendly, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference with an 8B debater on one consumer GPU is feasible but not free-tier-trivial.

novelty.reasoning: Debate-vs-consultancy known on QuALITY; the cross-domain transfer map may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Studied on QuALITY; cross-domain transfer plausibly open.
